scope.futureHandling: Complete archives hashed and parsed solely to extract <=2024 data; all features, labels, residuals and scores use only December2022 warmup and 2023/2024 observations.

limitations: No model refit: saved parameters and their source/row/artifact seals were verified and replayed.
Hourly 24h overlapping labels are not independent observations; calibration coverage and weekly confidence remain nominal diagnostics.
The audit verifies prediction and selection accounting, not execution fillability or true historical funding settlements.
